report.summary: All four UI failures share one root cause: app/main.py:150 calls time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) inside list_books, which runs on every /books render and after registration's redirect. Playwright's 5 s default timeout (tests/ui/conftest.py:7) therefore fails randomly whenever the delay exceeds about 5 s, so this is flaky rather than a product bug. Fix first by removing or disabling that artificial delay for the test run, or by making the test-side waits tolerant of it.

causes.title: Random 0-8 s delay in list_books makes /books page loads time out
causes.explanation: list_books sleeps for a random 0-8 seconds before querying the database, and render_books calls it on every /books page render (app/main.py:256). Playwright's page.goto waits for the 'load' event, and the UI fixture caps every action at 5000 ms (tests/ui/conftest.py:7). Whenever the random sleep exceeds roughly 5 s (about 37% of draws if uniform), page.goto('/books') times out. The register test fails the same way: the POST /register redirects to /books, and the click waits for that navigation, which includes the slow render. The outcome depends on chance, so a rerun of the same commit can pass. The underlying cause is the injected latency in the application code, and the tests have no tolerance for it. Confidence is high on the mechanism. It is not certain that the sleep alone explains all four failures, since the same render path also runs in tests that passed in this run, but nothing else in the code path is slow.
evidence: app/main.py:150: time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) inside list_books; the only sleep/random use in the app (search_code 'sleep|random').
app/main.py:256: render_books calls list_books(user["id"]) on every /books render, and books_page (app/main.py:311-314) renders it on GET /books.
tests/ui/conftest.py:7: page.set_default_timeout(5000) ('Nothing in this app should take longer than 5 s').
test_deleted_book_disappears: 'Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded.' call log 'navigating to "http://127.0.0.1:63002/books", waiting until "load"' at tests/support/pages.py:34.

test_future_year_shows_error_and_keeps_input: 'Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded.' on http://127.0.0.1:63001/books at tests/support/pages.py:34 (fails before the year assertion at tests/ui/test_books_ui.py:42-46 runs).
test_log_out_ends_the_session: 'Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded.' on http://127.0.0.1:63001/books at tests/ui/test_login_ui.py:37, before the logout click.

test_new_user_lands_on_empty_bookshelf: 'Locator.click: Timeout 5000ms exceeded' with call log 'click action done' then 'waiting for scheduled navigations to finish' (tests/support/pages.py:22). The click succeeded; the post-submit navigation to /books did not finish in time.
tests/conftest.py:41 uses time.sleep(0.2) only in the health-check poll, so it is unrelated.
causes.suggested_fix: Remove the time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) from list_books in app/main.py, or gate it behind an env var that is off during tests. If the latency is meant to be tested, put it behind an explicit opt-in and raise the navigation timeout for those tests only. Do not just raise the global 5 s timeout without addressing the delay, since that only shrinks the window. As a test-side hardening, use page.goto(..., wait_until='commit') or wait for a specific element with a longer explicit timeout for the /books page.
